helper_controls.command:
ruby -rjson -ropen3 -rdigest -e '
root, capture = ARGV
cases = [
 ["full_u64", File.join(root, "helper-full-u64.json"), nil, 0, nil],
 ["bad_manifest", File.join(root, "helper-bad-manifest.json"), nil, 1, /row count differs|row count/],
 ["noncanonical", File.join(root, "helper-noncanonical.json"), nil, 1, /non-minimal|nonminimal/],
 ["no_records", File.join(root, "helper-no-records.json"), nil, 1, /no structure records/],
 ["absent_profile", File.join(capture, "summary.json"), "does-not-exist", 1, /not found|missing|unknown|absent|no profile/]
]
results = []
%w[debug release].each do |mode|
 cases.each do |name, input, selected, expected, diagnostic|
  argv = [File.join(root, "helper-" + mode), input]
  argv << selected if selected
  out, err, status = Open3.capture3(*argv)
  ok = status.exitstatus == expected
  if expected == 0
   j = JSON.parse(out)
   row = j.fetch("records").fetch(0)
   ok &&= j.fetch("record_count") == 1 && row.fetch("row_count") == "18446744073709551615"
   manifest = JSON.parse(File.read(input)).fetch("profiles").fetch(0).fetch("physical_layout").fetch("chunk_layout").fetch("buckets").fetch("0").fetch("chunks").fetch(0)
   ok &&= row.fetch("reencoded_hex") == manifest.fetch("record_bytes_hex")
   ok &&= row.fetch("paths") == manifest.fetch("paths")
   ok &&= row.fetch("transport_pairs") == manifest.fetch("transport_pairs").transform_values { |pair| pair.map(&:to_s) }
  else
   ok &&= out.empty? && diagnostic.match?(err)
  end
  results << {mode: mode, case: name, argv: argv, actual_exit: status.exitstatus, expected_exit: expected, stdout_bytes: out.bytesize, stderr: err, stdout_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(out), check_passed: ok}
 end
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate(results)
exit(results.all? { |r| r[:check_passed] } ? 0 : 1)
' /private/tmp/crystal-click-w191-shared-advanced.sILD4Z /private/tmp/crystal-click-w191-native-final.BxiDQd > /private/tmp/crystal-click-w191-shared-advanced.sILD4Z/helper-controls.json

validator.fallback: Parse JSON; check exact changed-path allowlist; dereference every referenced file size/SHA; recompute implementation input identities; git diff --check.
validator.boundary: This validates shape, scope and current reference bytes, not command execution or model independence.
validator.command:
ruby -rjson -rdigest -e '
p=JSON.parse(File.read(ARGV[0]))
allowed=p.fetch("boundaries").fetch("allowed_paths").sort
changed=p.fetch("boundaries").fetch("changed_paths").sort
actual=(IO.popen(["git","diff",p.fetch("baseline_commit"),"--name-only"], &:read).lines.map(&:chomp)+IO.popen(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"], &:read).lines.map(&:chomp)).uniq.sort
abort "changed paths differ" unless allowed==changed && actual==changed
p.fetch("evidence").each { |e| path=e.fetch("path"); abort "missing #{path}" unless File.file?(path); abort "size #{path}" unless File.size(path)==e.fetch("bytes"); abort "digest #{path}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest==e.fetch("sha256") }
f=Dir.glob("{src,spec,scripts,examples}/**/*.{cr,rb}").sort
{"inputs"=>f,"source"=>f.select { |x| x.start_with?("src/") },"spec_inputs"=>f.select { |x| (x.start_with?("src/")||x.start_with?("spec/")) && x.end_with?(".cr") }}.each do |key, paths|
 expected=p.fetch("inputs").fetch(key)
 digest=Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(JSON.generate(paths.map { |x| [x,Digest::SHA256.file(x).hexdigest] }))
 abort "input identity #{key}" unless expected.fetch("count")==paths.size && expected.fetch("sha256")==digest
end
abort "scope" unless p.fetch("claim").fetch("scope").include?("NOT admitted")
abort "affected spec count" unless p.fetch("verification").fetch("affected_spec_files").size==82
puts "Packet JSON, 12-path scope, 32 current reference digests and implementation identities match; does not execute recorded commands."
' .landmark/evidence/object-shared-advanced-w191.json
